steps.speaker: FAC Alert
steps.content: City-wide temperatures are rising quickly. M-values of the three major Black Ring ruins are surging. The defense forces have requested urgent reinforcements.

steps.speaker: FAC Alert
steps.content: The Apostle of Ashes is confirmed to be attacking the DisSea defense line. The range of fluctuations is expanding. The Black Rings are showing city-wide fluctuations.

steps.speaker: FAC Alert
steps.content: Level S+ crisis response initiated. I repeat, level S+ crisis response initiated!

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: ...What's happening? Is that Apostle really so powerful...?

Approaching the boundary of BR-000, at the end of the Broken Frontline, the Sun Crow's flames already cover nearly half the sky. It's attacking humanity's last barrier ceaselessly. The FAC grapple with it while regrouping.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...The DisSea is boiling. The Apostle of Ashes is resonating with the Black Rings and amplifying its power. Is this a result of the Eastian sorcery breaking?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Reinforce the Broken Frontline and stop the Sun Crow. We must hold on by ourselves this time! It must not enter the DisSea!
The DisSea boils in resonance with the Apostle of Ashes. The sky is dyed red and the temperature is rising continuously. The air is filled with uncontrollable Mania, distorting your vision.
You see the three major Black Ring ruins flare up simultaneously, fiery pollution spurting outward. Your body burns like never before, and in a daze, all you see is...
The crimson sky catches fire slowly. The sun casts huge halos, the overlapping part growing brighter, until... they become blazing new suns.

steps.speaker: Indifferent Female Voice
steps.content: The sun deformed, demise befell; hills burned and charred, lives ebbed and fell.

steps.speaker: Indifferent Female Voice
steps.content: Ten suns in sky, lest crops survived. O hero's soul, when shall thou show?
On the chaotic battlefield, a figure walks up to you reciting a poem, and takes Yanyan from your nearly exhausted embrace.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: This is all we can do. Next...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Since DisCity doesn't believe in myths, fight in your own way then.
She doesn't stop at your call. But before she goes, you see a wave of the delicate fabric leaving a wisp of protective smoke around you.
